803-      # scope-admin-claim-to-path (AC2/AC3, code-review MAJOR M1 fix): a path is now
804-      # MANDATORY on every bootstrap completion, not merely accepted-when-present. AC3.2's
805-      # any-key-scan fallback exists ONLY for deployments that completed bootstrap BEFORE
806-      # this story shipped (their server_config genuinely has no admin_group_claim_path
807-      # row and never will, short of a manual re-run) — it must NOT be reachable via a
808-      # FRESH bootstrap simply by POSTing the pre-story param shape. Bootstrap completes
809-      # exactly once (guarded by bootstrap_completed?/0 above), so once this check is in
810-      # place there is no legitimate way for a new instance to end up path-less: every
811-      # first-time completion is forced through the path-carrying form field. The shipped
812-      # select_claim_html/1 template only ever emits "admin_group_claim_choice" going
813-      # forward, so a well-behaved client submission always has selected_path set; a
814-      # bare/legacy "admin_group_claim" param (old cached page, forged/replayed request,
815-      # browser devtools) is refused here rather than silently succeeding path-less.
816-      #
817-      # Checked BEFORE the discovered-value/pair checks below: resolve_selection/1 always
818-      # returns `{nil, nil}` together (never a non-nil value paired with a nil path), so
819-      # this is the correct, most-specific diagnostic for every legacy/malformed
820-      # submission — checking value-membership first would instead misreport them all as
821-      # "claim value not in verified token", masking the real (missing-path) reason.
822-      is_nil(selected_path) ->
823-        Logger.warning("bootstrap claim selection refused: no claim path submitted (path is mandatory on bootstrap completion)")
